GRENADA
Government Gazette

PPuubblliisshheedd bbyy AAuutthhoorriittyy
VOL. 144] SAINT GEORGE’S, WEDNESDAY, MARCH 11, 2026 [No. 12
GOVERNMENT NOTICE
____________
No. 12.
The following Act which has been assented to by Her Excellency the Governor-
General is published with this issue of the Gazette:—
No. 2 of 2026:— The Trademarks (Amendment) Act, 2026.
Copies of this Act may be seen at the Treasury, the Public Library, Post Offices, District
Revenue Offices and Police Stations.
11th March, 2026.
GRENADA
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, AT THE GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE,
ST. GEORGE’S
2026.
